Privacy policy

Effective October 17, 2026.

This website

The site serves static pages through Cloudflare Pages. It has no user accounts, login form or database for visitor profiles. The copy buttons use your browser's clipboard only when you press Copy. The site does not read your clipboard.

Analytics and hosting

Cloudflare Web Analytics is the only analytics service permitted for this site. When enabled, its beacon measures visits and performance. See Cloudflare Web Analytics and Cloudflare’s privacy policy for the provider's practices. Hosting providers may process network request information to deliver and secure the site.

Reports and external links

Code reports open on GitHub, whose account and privacy rules apply. Reports are public. Do not post passwords, email addresses, private account details or login codes. Links to Roblox, Discord and other sources take you to separate services with their own policies.

Future advertising

We plan to display third-party advertisements in the future. No advertising integration is included in this launch. Before adding one, we will update this policy with the provider, data practices, cookies and any required consent controls.

Questions

See the contact page for the currently available route. Do not send sensitive personal data in a public issue.
